description: Incoming Waste by Type and Waste Management Facility is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents annual data on the volume of waste received by various waste management facilities in Qatar, disaggregated by type of waste (domestic, construction, bulky, tires, other) and facility name. It helps track the flow of waste across major treatment and disposal sites. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are waste, domestic, construction, landfill. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
